docs.title: closeAll(String symbol, Integer magic, Boolean onlyProfit)
docs.text:
public void closeAll(String symbol, Integer magic, Boolean onlyProfit)

Close every open order, optionally filtered. symbol/magic restrict the set (null = any); onlyProfit = true closes only winners, false closes only losers, null closes all.

sugar.closeAll("EURUSD", null, null);     // flatten everything on EURUSD
sugar.closeAll(null, 777, true);          // take profit on all magic-777 winners

docs.text:

Delete pending orders only (market positions untouched), optionally filtered by symbol/magic.

docs.title: MT4Sugar — Trailing & Breakeven
docs.text:
Background workers that manage a stop for you, plus a one-shot move-to-breakeven.

setTrailingStop and autoBreakeven start a daemon worker thread and return a String subscription id; stop them with unsetTrailingStop(id) or unwatch(id). Each SL move emits an on_modify hook.

docs.title: setTrailingStop(int ticket, double distancePips, Double stepPips)
docs.text:
public String setTrailingStop(int ticket, double distancePips, Double stepPips)

Start trailing the stop distancePips behind the mid price (in the favorable direction only — it never loosens an existing SL). stepPips (optional) suppresses tiny adjustments smaller than that step. Returns the worker id. Throws if distancePips <= 0.

String id = sugar.setTrailingStop(ticket, 30, 10.0);   // trail 30 pips behind, min 10-pip steps
// ... later:
sugar.unsetTrailingStop(id);

docs.title: unsetTrailingStop(String subscriptionId)
docs.text:
public void unsetTrailingStop(String subscriptionId)

Stop a trailing worker (alias of unwatch).

docs.title: autoBreakeven(int ticket, double triggerPips, double plusPips)
docs.text:
public String autoBreakeven(int ticket, double triggerPips, double plusPips)

Start a worker that, once price moves triggerPips in profit, moves the SL to the entry price ± plusPips (locking in a small gain) and then stops itself. Returns the worker id. Throws if triggerPips <= 0.

String id = sugar.autoBreakeven(ticket, 20, 2.0);   // after +20 pips, SL -> entry +2
// stop early if needed:
sugar.unwatch(id);

docs.title: closeByBreakeven(int ticket, double plusPips)
docs.text:
public void closeByBreakeven(int ticket, double plusPips)

A one-shot move of the SL to the entry price ± plusPips (not a worker) — makes the trade risk-free immediately.

sugar.closeByBreakeven(ticket, 2.0);   // SL -> entry +2 pips now

docs.title: 🧩 Notes
docs.text:
• Daemon threads. Workers are daemon threads polling every ~0.3 s; they exit on their own when the order disappears or the quote read fails.
  • One id per worker. Keep the returned id to stop the worker; unwatch and unsetTrailingStop are interchangeable.
  • Direction-aware. For a BUY the stop trails up / breakeven sits above entry; for a SELL it's mirrored.

docs.title: MT4Sugar — Watchers & Waiters
docs.text:
Background stream subscriptions (watchers) and blocking awaiters for order lifecycle.

Each watch* wraps the matching MT4Account stream and returns a String subscription id stored internally; stop any of them with unwatch(id). The waiters block (polling) until a condition is met.

docs.text:

docs.text:
public List<OpenedOrderInfo> findOrders(String symbol, Integer magic, String side, String state, Double minProfit)

Open orders filtered by any combination (pass null to skip a filter):

docs.title: MT4Sugar — Master Overview
docs.text:
The high-level API: one-liners, pip-based SL/TP, risk sizing, trailing stops, watchers and waiters. The best starting point for most strategies.

MT4Sugar is Layer 3. It sits on top of MT4Service and turns the raw operations into ergonomic one-liners — you pass symbols, lots, pips and prices, and it handles normalization, enum mapping and plumbing.

Defined in MT4Sugar.java.

MT4Sugar    (HIGH)   one-liners, risk sizing, trailing, watchers  ← you are here
MT4Service  (MID)    friendly facade over MT4Account
MT4Account  (LOW)    raw gRPC / protobuf

Construct it from a connected service:

import pro.mrpc.mt4.MT4Account;
import pro.mrpc.mt4.MT4Service;
import pro.mrpc.mt4.MT4Sugar;

try (MT4Account account = new MT4Account(12345678L, "password", null, null, "TRIAL")) {
    MT4Service service = new MT4Service(account);
    service.connectByServerName("MetaQuotes-Demo", 30);
    MT4Sugar sugar = new MT4Sugar(service);      // ← the high-level API

    // one-liners:
    MT4Sugar.Quote q = sugar.lastQuote("EURUSD");
    double lots = sugar.calcLotByRisk("EURUSD", 1.0, 50, null);
    long ticket = sugar.buyMarket("EURUSD", lots, 50.0, 100.0, null, null, null, null, null);

    account.disconnect(false);
}

docs.text:
• 1. Connection & Defaults — ensureConnected, ping, ensureSymbol, setDefaults, getDefault, disconnect
  • 2. Prices & Quotes — lastQuote, midPrice, quotes, spreadPips, bars, ticks, waitPrice
  • 3. Symbol Math & Normalization — point, digits, pipSize, pipsToPrice, priceToPips, normalizePrice, normalizeLot, tickValue
  • 4. Risk Sizing — calcLotByRisk, calcCashRisk, breakevenPrice
  • 5. Order Entry — buyMarket, sellMarket, buyLimit, sellLimit, buyStop, sellStop, placeOrder
  • 6. Order Management — modifySlTpByPips, modifySlTpByPrice, close, closePartial, closeBy, closeByTickets, closeAll, cancelPendings
  • 7. Trailing & Breakeven — setTrailingStop, unsetTrailingStop, autoBreakeven, closeByBreakeven

docs.title: 🧩 Conventions
docs.text:
• Pips, not points. SL/TP and distances are in pips (slPips, tpPips, distancePips); Sugar converts to prices via the symbol's pip size (pip = 10 × point on 3/5-digit symbols).
  • Normalization is automatic. Lots are snapped to the volume step/limits and prices to the symbol's digit grid.
  • Defaults. setDefaults(symbol, magic, deviationPips, slippagePips, riskPercent) sets values reused across calls; order entry falls back to them when you pass null.
  • Background workers return an id. setTrailingStop / autoBreakeven / watch* return a String subscription id; stop them with unwatch(id) (or unsetTrailingStop(id)).
  • Hooks. The public hooks (HookBus) emits lifecycle events (on_order_sent, on_close, on_modify, …) — register with sugar.hooks.on("on_order_sent", payload -> …).
  • Errors raise MT4Error subclasses (OrderRejected, ModifyRejected, …) — see Errors.

docs.title: Strategies — Master Overview
docs.text: The ready-made orchestrators and presets that ship with JavaMT4: how to pick one, and links to each spec.

docs.title: ⚠️ Educational & demonstration only
docs.text:
These orchestrators and presets are demonstration templates — starting points for your own strategies, not production trading systems.

  • Simplified logic, no portfolio-level risk controls, no economic-calendar integration.
  • Demo accounts only. Each one opens a real 0.01-lot position and closes it again at the end of the demo window.
  • Trading involves substantial risk of loss; you are responsible for your decisions.

They live under src/main/java/strategies/ and are driven by MT4Sugar. The bundled examples run them from the menu (run.bat 11/12/15/16).

docs.title: 🚦 Orchestrators
docs.text:
Each orchestrator is a single static long run(MT4Sugar sugar, StrategyPreset sp, RiskPreset rp, …) that takes a StrategyPreset (what/where to enter) and a RiskPreset (how much to risk / protect), opens and manages a position, and returns the ticket.

Orchestrator run(...) extra arg What it does Demo Market One-Shot — Market entry with an automatic SL/TP bracket, optional trailing / auto-breakeven. run.bat 11 Bracket + Trailing double activateAtPips Entry with a bracket; the trailing stop switches on only once price is far enough in profit. run.bat 12 Pending Bracket int timeoutSeconds Place a BUY LIMIT with a bracket, wait for fill (else cancel), then arm management. run.bat 15

MT4-specific note: there is no Grid-DCA or OCO-straddle orchestrator in this SDK — MT4's single order list and broker hedging rules make those broker-dependent; build them yourself from the MT4Sugar primitives if you need them.

docs.title: 🎛️ Presets
docs.text:
Two small fluent classes configure every orchestrator (see Presets):

  • StrategyPreset — symbol, useMarket, entryPrice, lots, magic, deviationPips, comment.
  • RiskPreset — riskPercent, slPips, tpPips, trailingPips, beTriggerPips, bePlusPips.

Ready-made factories ship in Presets: marketEurusd(), limitEurusd(price), and the risk profiles conservative() / balanced() / aggressive(). run.bat 16 prints them all and runs a demo.

docs.title: 🔌 Usage pattern (Java)
docs.text:
import pro.mrpc.mt4.*;
import strategies.*;

try (MT4Account account = new MT4Account(12345678L, "password", null, null, "TRIAL")) {
    account.connectByServerName("MetaQuotes-Demo", 30);
    MT4Sugar sugar = new MT4Sugar(new MT4Service(account));

    StrategyPreset sp = new StrategyPreset("EURUSD").lots(0.01).magic(101).comment("market one-shot");
    RiskPreset     rp = new RiskPreset(1.0, 20).tp(40);

    long ticket = MarketOneShot.run(sugar, sp, rp);
    System.out.println("done #" + ticket);

    account.disconnect(false);
}

docs.title: 🧭 Which orchestrator?
docs.text:
• Simple entry with protection → Market One-Shot
  • Let winners run → Bracket + Trailing
  • Wait at a price with a bracket → Pending Bracket

docs.title: Bracket + Trailing Activation
docs.text:
Enter with a fixed SL/TP bracket, then switch on a trailing stop only once the trade has earned a profit cushion — "let it prove itself before trailing".

  • Source: src/main/java/strategies/BracketTrailing.java
  • Entry: static long run(MT4Sugar sugar, StrategyPreset sp, RiskPreset rp, double activateAtPips) → ticket
  • Demo: run.bat 12

docs.title: What it does
docs.text:
1. Applies presets as defaults; ensureConnected / ensureSymbol.
  2. Spread read (spreadPips) for context.
  3. Sizes the lot and enters at market with a pip bracket; waitFilled, then captures the fill price.
  4. Optional auto-breakeven guard (if beTriggerPips is set).
  5. Activation loop: polls the profit in pips; once it reaches activateAtPips, starts the trailing stop (trailingPips, default 15). In the short demo window it may not reach the threshold — it says so and would start live.
  6. Manages briefly, then tears down — unwatch workers and close.

Use it to give a trade room to develop before protecting profit with a trail.

docs.title: Signature
docs.text:
public static long run(MT4Sugar sugar, StrategyPreset sp, RiskPreset rp, double activateAtPips) throws Exception
Parameter Type Description sugar MT4Sugar A connected high-level client. sp StrategyPreset entry config (symbol, lots, magic, …). rp RiskPreset slPips/tpPips bracket; trailingPips (trail distance, default 15); optional beTriggerPips. activateAtPips double profit (pips) the trade must reach before trailing starts.

Returns: the opened order's ticket (long).

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
StrategyPreset sp = new StrategyPreset("EURUSD").lots(0.01).magic(102).comment("bracket+trailing");
RiskPreset rp = new RiskPreset(1.0, 20).tp(60).trailing(15).breakeven(10, 2);

long ticket = BracketTrailing.run(sugar, sp, rp, 12.0);   // start trailing after +12 pips

docs.title: Market One-Shot
docs.text:
Open a market order with an automatic SL/TP bracket, then optionally trail / auto-breakeven — the simplest orchestrator.

  • Source: src/main/java/strategies/MarketOneShot.java
  • Entry: static long run(MT4Sugar sugar, StrategyPreset sp, RiskPreset rp) → ticket
  • Demo: run.bat 11

docs.title: What it does
docs.text:
1. Applies the presets as Sugar defaults (setDefaults(symbol, magic, deviationPips, null, riskPercent)), then ensureConnected / ensureSymbol.
  2. Sizes the lot — fixed StrategyPreset.lots, or auto from RiskPreset.riskPercent + slPips via calcLotByRisk.
  3. Enters at market with a pip-based SL/TP bracket (buyMarket), then waitFilled.
  4. Optionally arms a trailing stop (if RiskPreset.trailingPips is set) and/or auto-breakeven (if beTriggerPips is set).
  5. Manages for a few seconds, prints a diagSnapshot, then tears down — unwatch the workers and close the position.

Use it when you simply want a protected market entry in one call.

docs.title: Signature
docs.text:
public static long run(MT4Sugar sugar, StrategyPreset sp, RiskPreset rp) throws Exception
Parameter Type Description sugar MT4Sugar A connected high-level client. sp StrategyPreset symbol, lots (null → size by risk), magic, deviationPips, comment. rp RiskPreset riskPercent, slPips, tpPips; optional trailingPips / beTriggerPips enable management.

Returns: the opened order's ticket (long).

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
StrategyPreset sp = new StrategyPreset("EURUSD").lots(0.01).magic(101)
        .deviation(3.0).comment("market one-shot");
RiskPreset rp = new RiskPreset(1.0, 20).tp(40).trailing(15).breakeven(10, 2);

long ticket = MarketOneShot.run(sugar, sp, rp);
System.out.println("ticket #" + ticket);

Omit .lots(...) on the StrategyPreset and sizing comes from riskPercent + slPips via calcLotByRisk. Set .trailing(...) / .breakeven(...) on the RiskPreset to arm the management workers.

docs.title: Pending Bracket
docs.text:
"Set your price and wait for the market to come to you": place a BUY LIMIT with an automatic SL/TP bracket, wait for fill, then arm management — or cancel on timeout.

  • Source: src/main/java/strategies/PendingBracket.java
  • Entry: static long run(MT4Sugar sugar, StrategyPreset sp, RiskPreset rp, int timeoutSeconds) → ticket
  • Demo: run.bat 15

docs.title: What it does
docs.text:
1. Applies presets as defaults; ensureConnected / ensureSymbol.
  2. Resolves the entry price — StrategyPreset.entryPrice if set, otherwise 5 pips below market (so the demo fills on a small dip).
  3. Sizes the lot and places a BUY LIMIT with a pip bracket (buyLimit).
  4. Waits for fill up to timeoutSeconds. On timeout it cancels pendings (cancelPendings) and returns.
  5. On fill: optional trailing / auto-breakeven (if set on the RiskPreset), manages briefly, then close.

Use it for patient, price-specific entries that protect themselves once live.

docs.title: Signature
docs.text:
public static long run(MT4Sugar sugar, StrategyPreset sp, RiskPreset rp, int timeoutSeconds) throws Exception
Parameter Type Description sugar MT4Sugar A connected high-level client. sp StrategyPreset entryPrice (optional — else 5 pips below market), lots, magic, comment. rp RiskPreset slPips/tpPips bracket; optional trailingPips / beTriggerPips. timeoutSeconds int how long to wait for the pending order to fill before cancelling.

Returns: the pending order's ticket (long) — note that on a fill-timeout the order is cancelled and the ticket is returned for reference.

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
StrategyPreset sp = new StrategyPreset("EURUSD").limitAt(1.0900).lots(0.01).magic(103).comment("pending bracket");
RiskPreset rp = new RiskPreset(1.0, 20).tp(40).trailing(15);

long ticket = PendingBracket.run(sugar, sp, rp, 30);   // wait up to 30s for the fill

Use .limitAt(price) on the StrategyPreset to set the pending price explicitly; omit it and the demo places the limit 5 pips below the current mid.

docs.text:
The two small fluent classes that configure every orchestrator, plus ready-made factories.

  • Source: src/main/java/strategies/StrategyPreset.java, RiskPreset.java, Presets.java
  • Demo: run.bat 16

Orchestrators take one StrategyPreset (what/where to enter) and one RiskPreset (how much to risk / protect):

long ticket = MarketOneShot.run(sugar, new StrategyPreset("EURUSD").lots(0.01), new RiskPreset(1.0, 20).tp(40));

docs.title: StrategyPreset
docs.text:
What and where to enter. Construct with a symbol, then chain fluent setters.

Field Type Default Meaning symbol String — trading symbol, e.g. "EURUSD" useMarket boolean true true = market entry; false = pending (needs entryPrice) entryPrice Double null price for a limit/stop entry lots Double null fixed lot size; null → auto-size from the RiskPreset magic int 0 order magic number deviationPips double 2.0 max slippage in pips comment String null order comment

Fluent setters: market(), limitAt(double price), lots(double), magic(int), deviation(double), comment(String).

StrategyPreset sp = new StrategyPreset("EURUSD").magic(777).deviation(2.0).comment("demo");
StrategyPreset pend = new StrategyPreset("EURUSD").limitAt(1.0900).lots(0.01);

docs.title: Ready-made factories (Presets)
docs.text: Factory Returns Presets.marketEurusd() Market EURUSD preset (magic 777). Presets.limitEurusd(double price) BUY LIMIT EURUSD at price (magic 778).

docs.title: RiskPreset
docs.text:
How much to risk and how to protect. Construct with riskPercent + slPips, then chain.

Field Type Default Meaning riskPercent double — % of equity to risk per trade (1.0 = 1%) slPips double — stop-loss distance in pips tpPips Double null take-profit distance in pips trailingPips Double null trailing-stop distance — set to enable trailing beTriggerPips Double null profit (pips) that arms auto-breakeven — set to enable auto-BE bePlusPips double 0.0 extra pips above the breakeven level

Fluent setters: tp(double pips), trailing(double pips), breakeven(double triggerPips, double plusPips).

RiskPreset rp = new RiskPreset(1.0, 20).tp(40).trailing(15).breakeven(10, 2);

docs.title: Ready-made risk factories (Presets)
docs.text: Factory Profile Presets.conservative() 0.5% risk, SL 25, TP 50 Presets.balanced() 1.0% risk, SL 20, TP 40, trail 15, BE 10/+2 Presets.aggressive() 2.0% risk, SL 15, TP 45, trail 10, BE 8/+1

docs.title: Putting it together
docs.text:
Presets.run(sugar, symbol) prints the catalog and runs a MarketOneShot with the balanced risk preset:

Presets.run(sugar, "EURUSD");

// or hand-pick:
MarketOneShot.run(sugar, Presets.marketEurusd(), Presets.conservative());

Separate WHAT from HOW MUCH: pick a strategy preset and a risk preset independently, then hand both to any orchestrator.
